purpose: Separate numerically complete Integrated Gradients explanations according to sensitivity across the 32 benign references and audit disagreement-case sensitivity to alternative baseline definitions.
interpretation: Numerical completeness establishes that the attributions reconstruct the selected logit difference. It does not establish that the same feature ranking or direction is obtained from every valid benign reference.
cnn_scope_warning: The saved CNN operates over the fixed ordered 78-feature vector. Integrated Gradients identifies sensitivity to feature positions, but does not by itself validate spatial locality between adjacent tabular features.
